title: Education
exampleQuestions: Which school does Hamza go to?
answer: Hamza is in the fourth year of the Computer Science Master's program at INSA Lyon (2025 to 2028), a leading French public engineering school with a five-year integrated program. Before that he followed INSA Lyon's Intensive Undergraduate Program, International Asia Track (2023 to 2025), with mathematics, physics, computer science and Japanese courses. Relevant coursework: Algorithms and Data Structures, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Software Engineering and OOP, Artificial Intelligence, Probability and Project Management.
